.]] A Public Test Realm (or PTR, test server, and test realm) is a special server where upcoming features are tested for the next upcoming patch. There are separate PTR servers for each flavor, and each has one or more realms. You can make a character on the test realm from a copy of one of your characters on a normal realm or from a premade. Whether there will be premade or not will be clearly announced. Players on test realms should not be surprised by character wipes, item wipes, or frequent downtime to make changes or apply patches, so don't get too attached to your character on these servers. For a guide to getting on the test realm, see Getting on the Test Realm.

.]] The Proudmoore flagship is a Kul Tiran battleship that formerly served Daelin Proudmoore. She used it to travel to Lordaeron Keep during the Battle for Lordaeron, to Kul Tiras, and to Zandalar during the Battle of Dazar'alor, where it served as part of her encounter area.

Pull, pulling, etc. Generally used to refer to the act of starting combat, normally with the aim to single out one (or as few as possible) mob(s) from a larger group, with the intent to kill the pull target(s) without aggroing the other mob(s). In Vanilla and TBC, skilled pulling was an art form, and in many cases the key to winning a fight. Garr and High King Maulgar were legendary for the difficulty of the initial pull, several 5 player instances featured very interesting combinations of trash mob patrol patterns. The question which class should pull is hotly contested, and probably has no correct answer. The most important factor is (as always) player skill. Nontheless in some situations,

Purple Lotus is a Herb found in Felwood that can be gathered with Herbalism (210). Purple Lotus is one of the four types of Lotus and the most common of the four types. Visually, it appears to be a purple flower and a little bit of white/green near the ground. Tainted Moths prefer to feed on Purple Lotus nectar.

The color purple is used in World of Warcraft in various different ways, but mostly for Epic items. It is more valuable than Blue (rare), but less valuable than Orange (Legendary). Purple is the national color of Dalaran and the Twilight's Hammer clan. Void is also purple.
